about.title: About SmartCalcTools
about.subtitle: Calculators for zakat, inheritance and Islamic finance — each one shows its basis.
about.mission_desc1: Most zakat calculators online hand you a number and never say where it came from. When one disagrees with another, you have no way to judge which to trust or why they differ. This site is built on the opposite principle: every result sits beside its basis — the standard behind it, the school of law where the question is disputed, and the limits of what the tool can tell you.
about.mission_desc2: Every calculation runs inside your browser. Your figures are not sent to a server and are not stored by us, and you can verify that by disconnecting from the internet after the page loads — the calculators keep working.
about.zero_trust_desc: The zakat nisab is computed from a live gold price rather than a fixed figure that quietly goes stale, with a fallback that takes over if the source fails — and says so rather than hiding it. The Hijri converter follows the Umm al-Qura calendar and rejects a date that does not exist with a message explaining why, instead of silently rounding to the nearest day. The inheritance calculator passes twenty-three reference cases with known answers, covering awl, radd, the two Umariyyah cases and exclusion.
about.islamic_finance_title: The Sharia basis, and its limits
about.islamic_finance_desc: The calculators follow AAOIFI standards: No. 35 for zakat, No. 8 for murabaha, No. 13 for mudarabah, No. 17 for sukuk. Where a question is disputed we say so and name the opposing position — as with the grandfather and brothers, where this tool follows the Hanafi view while the majority hold otherwise, so anyone following another school will find their share stated differently here. The inheritance cases have not yet been reviewed by a Sharia board, and we say that plainly on the page itself. What you get here is a calculation to work from and a method to understand, not a fatwa that removes the need to ask a scholar who knows your situation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_title: 1. Your Financial Numbers Never Leave Your Device
privacy.section1_desc1: Every number you enter into our calculators — your zakat wealth, your gold weight, an estate value, financing amounts — is processed entirely inside your own browser. None of it is sent to a server we operate, and none of it is stored by us. You can verify this yourself: open any calculator, then disconnect from the internet — it keeps working.
privacy.section1_desc2: You can verify this yourself: our calculators keep working even if you disconnect your internet after the page loads. We built it this way deliberately, because we understand these are sensitive personal financial figures, and you should never have to worry when entering them.
privacy.section2_title: 2. Optional Services That Do Collect Limited Data
privacy.section2_desc1: If you voluntarily subscribe to our free annual Zakat reminder, we store only your email address and your chosen reminder month in our database (Vercel/Neon Postgres), solely to send you one reminder per year. We use double opt-in — you must click a confirmation link in your inbox before any reminder is ever sent — and you can unsubscribe with a single click via the link included in every email.
privacy.section2_desc2: If you use our Contact form, the name, email, and message you submit are sent to us via Resend (a transactional email service) purely so we can reply to you — you are never added to a marketing list because of this. We also use Upstash Redis to briefly process your IP address for spam and abuse prevention only; it is never linked to your identity or stored long-term.
privacy.section3_desc1: To keep the lights on, we use website analytics (Google Analytics) and may display advertisements via Google AdSense. These services may use cookies or similar technologies, subject to the consent you give via our cookie banner.
privacy.section3_desc2: **Crucially:** These third parties have zero access to the figures you process within our calculators (Section 1 above) — those stay strictly local to your browser and are never seen by Google or anyone else.
privacy.section4_desc: Some tools may use your browser's local storage to save your preferences (like Dark Mode settings). This data remains on your device and can be cleared at any time through your browser settings.

zakat.title: Zakat Calculator
zakat.subtitle: Calculate your annual Zakat (2.5%) easily and accurately according to Islamic guidelines. No data is saved.
zakat.nisab_description: Based on current global market prices for 85 grams of Gold.
zakat.api_failed: ⚠️ Could not fetch live gold prices. Please enter the Nisab value manually based on 85g gold price in your local currency.
zakat.status_eligible: 🎉 Your net assets exceed the Nisab threshold. You are eligible to pay Zakat.
zakat.status_not_eligible: ℹ️ Your net assets are below the Nisab threshold. You are not required to pay Zakat.
zakat.note1: Nisab is the minimum amount of wealth a Muslim must possess for a full lunar year (Hawl) before Zakat becomes due.
zakat.note2: Nisab is equivalent to 85 grams of gold or 595 grams of silver. This calculator uses 85g of gold as the default standard.
zakat.note3: Zakat is calculated at 2.5% of your net cumulative wealth above the Nisab.
zakat.note4: Debts and immediate expenses should be deducted from your total assets before calculating Zakat.
